exact_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept

Style/medium: charming endearing compact oldschool pixel art, expressive readable face, crisp deliberate chunky pixel clusters, restrained shading and dark colored outline; unified cranial head size and sturdy connected anatomy. Do not elongate limbs or torso. Middle body build, approx 2.7 heads high with volume rather than stretched height; the final assembler will make body 63 pixels high inside 128 pixel cells.
Composition: exactly 8 equal columns x 4 equal rows, landscape sheet. Each sprite centered in its own invisible cell with generous fully transparent gutters and margin. Entire head, hands, feet, costume, tail/wings when present must fit intact. No sprites touching.
Every row has these precise eight distinct directions LEFT TO RIGHT: column0 S straight FRONT facing viewer; column1 SE FRONT-RIGHT 45 degrees; column2 E RIGHT PROFILE; column3 NE BACK-RIGHT 45 degrees with back of head and NO frontal eyes; column4 N straight BACK with NO face; column5 NW BACK-LEFT 45 degrees with back of head and NO frontal eyes; column6 W LEFT PROFILE; column7 SW FRONT-LEFT 45 degrees.

Four rows, never five. Keep body shape, head size, costume and scale consistent through all 32 poses; head, torso, arms, hands, legs, feet physically connected.
No weapons, staves, held tools, baked spells, magic particles, aura, ground shadow, ground plane, scene, labels, letters, watermarks, visible grid or checkerboard. Actual transparent background with alpha=0 between figures.
Subject: Hesus Christo, current ancestry ELF, not a dragon or wyrm. Pale warm skin, very long pointed ears, black swept-back tousled hair with long hair at nape, friendly determined expressive face. Deep forest green structured tunic/short coat with gold edging, gold square belt buckle, brown leather bracers, dark pants, brown boots. Preserve Image 1 current elf identity and green-gold costume, no horns, wings or tail, no weapon.
